component.name: Awakened PoE Trade Native
component.summary: Native Linux Path of Exile trade overlay

description.p: A native Qt and KDE host for the Awakened PoE Trade interface, with Wayland overlays, global shortcuts, tray integration, trade lookup, clipboard actions, game-log tracking, Heist OCR, and native updates.

developer.name: Awakened PoE Trade and Native Contributors

description.p: Fixes AppImage startup on glibc 2.43 systems by pinning a compatible Fortran runtime and validating the glibc requirement of every bundled library during packaging.

Integrates Awakened PoE Trade 3.29.102 data and parsing, adds localized Allflame Chart price checks, updates Path of Exile 3.29 item capture, and shares official-site browser challenge cookies with the native trade proxy.
Adds passive text-field editing and Escape handling without giving the overlay keyboard focus or revealing Plasma's taskbar.
Fixes KWin bridge discovery on clean systems by loading the bridge directly from the AppImage's bundled data directory.
Fixes transparent overlays in the AppImage by explicitly bundling and validating Qt's Wayland EGL rendering integration.
Restores complete modifier parsing and native numeric filter entry, fixes tray shutdown and external-window behavior, and improves system-browser activation on Wayland.
Hardens native releases with pinned inputs, provenance and SBOM attestations, expands Wayland backend tests, and adds native documentation plus automatic upstream monitoring.
